Is Xcel Right for Your Child?

We are an after school facility that offers competitive gymnastics. Our Xcel program has the same "detail" requirements as a Developmental Program, but our team girls practice fewer hours, which allows time for homework and other activities.

Our goal is to offer a fun, flexible environment where gymnasts can learn new skills and advance levels at their own pace.

How to Join the Xcel Team

There are two ways onto the team, depending on whether your child already trains at PAC.

Already in PAC Classes

Move Up Through Our Classes

Classes are for ages 5–10. Gymnasts earn tips as they learn each skill and are awarded the next belt once they've received all their tips.

  1. Beginner
  2. Intermediate
  3. Advanced
  4. PreTeam
  5. Xcel Team
9

Every child learns differently. There's no set number of weeks at each level. We evaluate gymnasts every 9 weeks and move them up when they're ready.

Joining the team after PreTeam isn't required, but we strongly recommend it.

New to PAC

Book a Private Evaluation

If you're new to PAC and unsure of your child's placement, a coach will evaluate your child's current skills and recommend the right class or team level.

Request an Evaluation

PAC Xcel Competition Levels

PAC's AAU competitive team competes in five Xcel levels. Gymnasts are placed by evaluation and work up the ladder from Copper to Platinum, with practice time growing as they advance.

  1. Level 1

    Copper

    3 hours a week

    Team Routine and Music

  2. Level 2

    Bronze

    5 hours a week

    Team Routine and Music

  3. Level 3

    Silver

    8 hours a week

    Team Routine and Music

  4. Level 4

    Gold

    9 hours a week

    Individual Choreography

  5. Level 5

    Platinum

    10 hours a week

    Individual Choreography

Moving Up a Level

Team gymnasts are evaluated each July for the next season. Coaches look at:

  • Mastery of routines
  • Work ethic
  • Maturity
  • Behavior
  • Physical strength
  • Skill progression

Gymnasts move up once they have mastered and perfected their routines and skill requirements consistently on all four events: vault, bars, beam, and floor.

Xcel FAQs

Is Xcel Less Serious than a Developmental Program?

No. Xcel has the same "detail" requirements. The difference is fewer practice hours, which leaves time for homework and other activities.

Does My Child Have to Join the Team After PreTeam?

No. It isn't required, but we strongly recommend it. It's the best training program for reaching higher goals in gymnastics.

When Are Team Placements Decided?

Team gymnasts are evaluated each July for the following season. Gymnasts in classes are evaluated every 9 weeks.

What Are the Practice Times and Tuition?

Practice hours depend on level: Copper practices 3 hours a week, Bronze 5, Silver 8, Gold 9 and Platinum 10. We'll share the exact practice days and times, plus the team fee sheet, at your evaluation.
